shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files -g '"'!*node_modules*'"' | head -200"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e \"import fs from 'node:fs';const p='src/App.tsx';fs.writeFileSync(p, \\"'`import { Flex, Switch, Text, useTheme } from '"'@gravity-ui/uikit';\\nimport { useEffect, useState } from 'react';\\n\\nconst THEME_STORAGE_KEY = 'gravity-theme';\\nconst THEMES = ['light', 'dark'] as const;\\n\\ntype Theme = (typeof THEMES)[number];\\n\\nfunction readStoredTheme(): Theme {\\n  const storedTheme = localStorage.getItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY);\\n  return THEMES.find((theme) => theme === storedTheme) ?? 'light';\\n}\\n\\nexport function App() {\\n  const { theme, setTheme } = useTheme();\\n  const [isDark, setIsDark] = useState(() => readStoredTheme() === 'dark');\\n\\n  useEffect(() => {\\n    localStorage.setItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY, isDark ? 'dark' : 'light');\\n  }, [isDark]);\\n\\n  useEffect(() => {\\n    setTheme(isDark ? 'dark' : 'light');\\n  }, [isDark, setTheme]);\\n\\n  return (\\n    <Flex direction=\\\"column\\\" gap={4} style={{ padding: 24 }}>\\n      <Text variant=\\\"header-2\\\">Theme</Text>\\n      <Switch checked={isDark} onUpdate={setIsDark}>\\n        Dark theme\\n      </Switch>\\n      <Text color=\\\"secondary\\\">Selected theme: {theme}</Text>\\n    </Flex>\\n  );\\n}\\n\\\");\" && npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc "perl -0pi -e \"s/type Theme =/type AppTheme =/; s/(): Theme \\{/(): AppTheme {/g\" src/App.tsx
npm run build"

npm run build"
